blocks.title: Electronic configuration
blocks.text: Electronic configuration kisi atom ya ion ke dastiyab shells, subshells ya orbitals mein electrons ki taqseem hai.

Subshells ke liye configuration subshell symbols ki ek fehrist ke taur par likhi jati hai, ek ke baad ek, har ek ke daen oopar (superscript) subshell ke electrons ki tadaad ke saath. Be-9 atom ki configuration, 1s subshell mein do aur 2s subshell mein do electrons, 1s2 2s2 likhi jati hai. Orbital diagram mein subshell ke orbitals ka har giroh apni subshell notation se label hota hai aur har electron ek teer se dikhaya jata hai, s = +1/2 ke liye oopar aur s = -1/2 ke liye neeche. Boron (B-11, Z = 5) ka orbital diagram yeh hai: 1s mein do jure teer, 2s mein do jure teer, 2px mein ek teer, aur 2py aur 2pz khali.

blocks.alt: Boron ka orbital diagram: 11/5 B = 1s 2s 2px 2py 2pz; 1s aur 2s ke oopar ulte teeron ka joRa, 2px ke oopar ek oopar wala teer, aur 2py aur 2pz ke oopar 0.
blocks.caption: Boron ka orbital diagram (kitab ke 2.7 mein be-unwan diagram ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Nitrogen (Z = 7) ki subshell configuration likhein aur us ke orbital diagram ko bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen 1s2 2s2 2p3 hai. Orbital diagram mein 1s aur 2s mein ek ek jora ulte teeron ka hai, aur teen 2p khanon px, py aur pz mein ek ek oopar ka teer.

items: Electronic configuration shells, subshells ya orbitals par electrons ki taqseem hai, jo subshell symbols ke saath superscript mein electron ginti (Be: 1s2 2s2) ya spins ke teeron wale orbital diagrams se likhi jati hai.
